metaDescription: Chow Chow vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Chow Chow boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Chow Chows: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Chow Chow series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class medium does not invent new viruses for the Chow Chow, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final DA2PP / DHPP booster.
Flag entropion at Chow Chow vaccine checkups so the puppy’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Chow Chow series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Chow Chow shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Chow Chow make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Chow Chow antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Chow Chow dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium dog.
Reset the Chow Chow reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Chow Chow core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Chow Chow misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Chow Chow health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Chow Chow adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
